improvements_suggested: Repair the milestone-scoped timing detector: add an mtime scan of results/experiment_*.json plus an ops/changelog-window fallback so artifacts that exist on disk are attributed to the active milestone — this ends the .363-.416 false-zero streak that forces every retro to hand-reconcile on-disk ground truth.

Stamp duration_s and a compute_bound boolean into every artifact at write time (from scripts/experiment_template.py), so the retro reads per-task execution cost directly instead of inferring it from commit timestamps.

Emit a detector_gap_suspected flag whenever the detector reports 0 commits but results/ contains artifacts newer than the prior milestone's window, so the false-zero self-announces in-band rather than silently propagating into the locked 0/null retro fields.

Sample the GPU snapshot during the execution window (or periodically through the milestone), not ~4h after it closes — the current post-hoc snapshot cannot detect mid-run GPU idle even on a genuinely compute-bound task.

Emit detector_gap_suspected whenever artifacts exist on disk but the detector reports 0, so the gap is flagged in-band instead of being silently encoded as a zero.
